choices.text: Broadcast the pattern to every ship in range.
Lock it under a quarantine council.
Bury the fragments. Lie about all of it.

scenes.text:
Dawn over the crash field. The three fragments hum in the cold air, and you understand, finally, that the signal isn't a message [i]about[/i] something.

It is a message [i]to[/i] someone. And everyone who hears it gets to answer.

Meridian wants your recommendation before the tribunal convenes. This is the choice the whole dive comes down to, {name}.
scenes.title: WHAT WE CARRY UP
